system.sensesNotes: Darkvision 120 ft, Tremorsense 60 ft in water
system.tactics: Sea Monsters attack ships as territory violations, striking the hull first and then targeting the crew that reaches the deck. They use Tidal Wake to scatter defenders before biting through the most isolated target. They do not retreat from a vessel they have claimed unless driven off by severe injury.
system.attacksNotes:
Maw [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 7 + Melee Combat 7), Reach: 15 ft

  • Margin 1:: 19 damage (12 + 7 Str)
  • Margin 2: 19 damage, DR halved (round up); target is Grappled

Tail Sweep [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 7 + Melee Combat 7) against every creature within 15 feet behind the Sea Monster

  • Margin 1:: 17 damage (10 + 7 Str); target is pushed 10 ft
  • Margin 2: 17 damage, DR halved (round up); target is pushed 20 ft and knocked Prone

Multiattack [Combat]: The Sea Monster makes one Maw attack and one Tail Sweep attack. Shared Attribute Roll (Agil 4): Roll Agility once and apply it to both ### Attacks.
system.specialAbilitiesNotes: Tidal Wake: When the Sea Monster moves at least 30 feet through water, each creature and unsecured object within 10 feet of its path must make a Reflex save or be pushed 10 feet and knocked Prone. A creature that succeeds is pushed 5 feet instead. Ramming Bulk: If the Sea Monster moves at least 30 feet straight toward a vessel or structure, it deals 30 bludgeoning damage to the target and makes a Maw attack against one creature on or beside it. Aquatic Body: The Sea Monster can breathe water indefinitely. On land, it moves at half speed and adds 1 to both attack dice. Action Points (3): Boss template. Spend at the end of any other creature's turn: Move (1, up to half speed), Attack (1, no Multiple Action Penalty), Detect (1), Special Ability (2). Regains all at the start of its own turn.
